import base64
from llama_index.core.base.llms.types import ImageBlock, ChatMessage
from pydantic import ValidationError

png_b64 = b"iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
png = base64.b64decode(png_b64)

# Task 2: default encoding is base64
b = ImageBlock(image=png)
assert b.encoding == "base64", b.encoding
assert b.image == png_b64, "default should base64-encode"
assert b.image_mimetype == "image/png"

# Task 2: explicit base64
b = ImageBlock(image=png, encoding="base64")
assert b.image == png_b64

# Task 2: raw encoding keeps raw bytes
b = ImageBlock(image=png, encoding="raw")
assert b.encoding == "raw"
assert b.image == png, "raw should keep raw bytes"
assert b.image_mimetype == "image/png"

# Task 2: resolve_image with raw
img = b.resolve_image(); assert img.read() == png
img = b.resolve_image(as_base64=True); assert img.read() == png_b64

# Task 2: resolve_image with default base64 still works
b = ImageBlock(image=png)
img = b.resolve_image(); assert img.read() == png
img = b.resolve_image(as_base64=True); assert img.read() == png_b64

# Task 2: invalid encoding rejected
try:
    ImageBlock(image=png, encoding="utf-8")
    raise AssertionError("expected ValidationError")
except ValidationError:
    pass

# Task 1: lazy mimetype accessor
b = ImageBlock(image=png)
assert b.get_image_mimetype() == "image/png"

# explicit mimetype not re-guessed
b = ImageBlock(image=png, image_mimetype="image/jpeg")
assert b.get_image_mimetype() == "image/jpeg"
assert b.image_mimetype == "image/jpeg"

# caching: no image, no mimetype -> None, stays None
b = ImageBlock()
assert b.get_image_mimetype() is None
assert b.get_image_mimetype() is None

# unrecognizable bytes -> None
b = ImageBlock(image=b"notanimage")
assert b.get_image_mimetype() is None

# path-only block: no guess from path/url
b = ImageBlock(url="http://example.com")
assert b.get_image_mimetype() is None

# caching semantics: mimetype resolved lazily and cached on the model
b = ImageBlock(image=png, encoding="raw")
b.image_mimetype = None
assert b.get_image_mimetype() == "image/png"  # wait - image is raw, guess works
assert b.image_mimetype == "image/png"

# ChatMessage integration with encoding field
m = ChatMessage(content=[ImageBlock(image=png, encoding="raw")])
assert m.blocks[0].image == png
d = m.model_dump()
assert d["blocks"][0]["encoding"] == "raw"

# roundtrip: model_validate with encoding field
b2 = ImageBlock.model_validate(ImageBlock(image=png, encoding="raw").model_dump())
assert b2.image == png

print("ALL SANITY CHECKS PASSED")
EOF
